subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Which QQ Bot identities may resolve implicit plugin approvals in direct C2C conversations when execApprovals is not configured?
rationale: Current behavior deliberately fails closed, while the linked PR treats every direct conversation as trusted; selecting the permanent actor-authorization contract requires explicit security ownership.

options.title: Require canonical authorization
options.body: Keep the existing QQ Bot authorization resolver and repair direct approvals only for explicitly authorized owners, approvers, access groups, or equivalent authenticated operator identities.

options.title: Trust all direct chats
options.body: Treat every direct C2C callback as authorized, accepting that open-DM users may resolve sensitive plugin approvals.

options.title: Require explicit approval configuration
options.body: Continue failing closed unless execApprovals is configured, but improve the callback response and setup guidance so users can recover without waiting for a timeout.

recommendation.title: Require canonical authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the existing QQ Bot authorization resolver and repair direct approvals only for explicitly authorized owners, approvers, access groups, or equivalent authenticated operator identities.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently defined and verified the canonical fallback authorization design and is best positioned to resolve its direct-message security contract.
